fields.name: compressive_strength_class
fields.rationale: The compressive strength class (e.g., C20/25) is a key property that defines the load-bearing capacity of the concrete, which is crucial for structural applications.
evidence: This data set refers to the production of 1m³ recycling ready-mix concrete of compressive strength class C20/25.

fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a fundamental property of concrete that affects its weight and structural performance, and is explicitly provided in the dataset.

fields.name: exposure_class
fields.rationale: Exposure class indicates the environmental conditions the concrete is designed to withstand, which is critical for durability and application suitability.
evidence: The concrete mix design used for this data set can be used for exposure class X0 applications.
inference_basis: Exposure class X0 is mentioned, suggesting other classes may be relevant.
